source.description: Try store A first. Try store B only when A fails or is explicitly not selected. Verify the selected store through the same user path.

outcomes.text: Users can save and retrieve a note.

features: Save and retrieve a note using the selected store

slices.title: Try store A
slices.behavior: A note saved through store A survives reopening.

acceptance.check: Store A returns the saved note after reopening.
acceptance.observable: Save a note, reopen it, and compare its text.

slices.title: Try fallback store B
slices.behavior: A note saved through store B survives reopening.

acceptance.check: Store B returns the saved note after reopening.
acceptance.observable: Save a note, reopen it, and compare its text.

slices.title: Verify the selected store
slices.behavior: Users save and retrieve notes through the selected store.

acceptance.check: The selected store preserves the user's note across a restart.
acceptance.observable: Save a note, restart the application, and retrieve the same text.
